deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep org.clojure/clojure, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package. nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

test/kotoba/verifier_signing_cross_host_.reason: The suite opens fixture files by a path relative to the old repository root (test/...). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so each such path names the file where it now lives (lib/kotoba.kotobaVerifier/test/...). Nothing else in the file changes.

src/kotoba/verifier/native_signing.kotob.reason: Add canonical Kotoba adapter for the existing base64 X.509 SPKI and signature wire format to Amu selfhost Ed25519 verification. This keeps DER parsing and canonical base64 validation in Kotoba source without a JVM or Node crypto runtime.

test/native/signing_wire_probe.kotoba.reason: Add a fixed-vector native selfhost probe for the canonical Ed25519 wire adapter, including positive and refusal cases.

bin/check-native-signing-selfhost.reason: Add a reproducible KSL2 Amu selfhost check/compile/direct-run/artifact-run gate for the signing wire probe; the oracle is a fixed fixture, not a runtime dependency.
